title: PowerPoint on the web: reference an attached deck's style when creating a presentation with Copilot Agent Mode
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout facts match the roadmap, and Microsoft's documentation supports the described workflow, licence requirement and licence controls. It distinguishes the older Agent Mode name and related permissions guidance from this item's own release note.

claims.where: Scope; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Assigning licences in the Microsoft 365 admin center requires at least a License Administrator or User Administrator.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.claim: User licence assignments are controlled in Microsoft 365 admin center at Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses.
claims.quote:
go to the Users > Active users page.
Select the row of the user
In the right pane, select Licenses and Apps.
Expand the Licenses section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @() assigns the selected licence to a user.
claims.quote:
To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell.
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: The Graph PowerShell licence-assignment route needs User.ReadWrite.All or another permission listed in the Assign license API reference.
claims.quote: Assigning and removing licenses for a user requires the User.ReadWrite.All permission scope or one of the other permissions listed in the 'Assign license' Microsoft Graph API reference page.
